title: UniPool global expert pool with layer role views
hypothesis: Small layer-specific input/output coordinate Views recover layer-specialized functions from one global physical expert pool with fewer complete bytes than per-layer experts, while retaining router quality and reasonable active compute.
physical_object: one global bank of four 8x8 experts with a per-layer router
mirror_coordinate: per-layer four-angle Givens coordinate code applied around shared experts
logical_multiplicity: sixteen layer-expert operators from four physical experts and four layer codes

development.selection_metric: routed heldout output nRMSE, complete serialized payload bytes and router+expert MACs

fresh.reason: exact native direct-angle alias is tested before opening fresh data

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: Routed output nRMSE <=0.02, >=25% fewer complete bytes than independent layer experts, and strict storage/quality/compute improvement over UniPool and direct-angle Givens controls.
failure_gate: FAIL for Mirror-specific value if the native direct-angle control exactly aliases the view, or if router/quality/byte/compute gates are missed.
boundaries: Synthetic linear experts and fixed random routers only; no trained UniPool/MoE, language model NLL or accelerator throughput claim.
The direct-angle Givens control is paid at identical precision and payload completeness.
No training or fresh task identity evaluation; operator maps are oracle generated.
